author: Alice
body: Employees may work remotely up to 4 days per week. Core collaboration hours are 10am-3pm in the employee local timezone. Manager approval is required for fully remote arrangements exceeding 4 days.

author: Eve
body: New hires should complete IT setup, benefits enrollment, and the security training module within their first week. Buddy assignments happen on day one.

author: Dave
body: Q3 priorities: ship the new rate limiter, finish the websocket reliability fixes, and begin design work on the multi-agent knowledge base project.

author: Bob
body: Expenses under 100 dollars do not require pre-approval. Travel expenses require manager sign-off before booking. Reimbursement requests must be submitted within 30 days.

author: Frank
body: All employees must enable two-factor authentication on company accounts. Laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled. Report any suspected security incident to security@acme.example within 1 hour.

author: Grace
body: Performance reviews happen twice a year, in April and October. Each cycle includes a self-assessment, peer feedback, and a manager evaluation. Ratings feed into the annual compensation review.

author: Grace
body: All new parents, including adoptive and foster parents, are eligible for 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Leave can be taken within the first 12 months after the child arrives.

author: Grace
body: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO per year. Unused PTO up to 5 days can roll over to the next year. PTO requests should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance where possible.

author: Carol
body: When an incident is declared, the on-call engineer opens an incident channel, pages the incident commander, and posts updates every 15 minutes until resolution. A postmortem is required within 5 business days.

author: Bob
body: New vendor contracts over 5000 dollars annually require Finance and Legal sign-off before signing. Use the vendor intake form in the Finance Notion space to start the process.
